turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will take care of you, O-lan, and do what you wish, but you must not talk like this. You are not going anywhere, you are going to rest and get well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, marry the maid, it is the only thing left for me to wish for. I have seen it in my mind, she will be a good wife to you.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will do as you wish, but do not worry about me, I will take care of myself.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: But what will become of the maid when I am gone? She is a good one, and I have taught her well.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I swear to you, O-lan, that I will take care of the maid, she will be like a daughter to me, and I will see that she is well provided for.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I will take care of the maid, you need not worry about her. I will make sure she has a home and food, and I will visit her often.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I have lived a good life, but I am not at peace until I see you both settled. I will rest easy knowing the maid will have a home with you, my son.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: Do not trouble yourself, my love, I will not let you worry about the maid, I swear it to you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am glad, my son, that you are willing to take care of the maid. But I must speak with your father, alone, about our plans for your marriage.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will not have you exhausting yourself, my love, with talk of our plans for the future. You must rest, and let me take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must know, my son, that you will not forget your duty to the maid, and that you will treat her with kindness and respect.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you must not speak of these things, you are weakening yourself and I will not let you do it.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I must see my son settled before I go, it is my duty to you and to our family.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I don't know, honored mother-in-law, what I can do to help. I am but a lowly maid, I am not worthy of your son's attention.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you are weak, my son, but I must see this through. You must promise me that you will take care of the maid and settle down soon.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, I promise you, I will take good care of the maid and settle down as soon as I can. You have always been so kind to me, and I want to make you happy before you go.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I-I am not worthy of your son's attention, honored mother-in-law, but I will do my best to help him settle down and take care of me, if that is your wish.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I know you will take care of the maid, my son, but I want to see her settled in our home, not just as a maid, but as a daughter.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Honored mother-in-law, I am grateful for your kindness, but I fear I am not worthy of such consideration. I am but a lowly maid, and I do not know if I can ever be a true daughter in your eyes.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: My son, do not be weak, I can see it in your eyes. I know you will take care of the maid, but I want to see the day when you bring a bride into our home, not just any bride, but one who is worthy of you.
